record.question: From which launch vehicle was GSAT-29 launch into space by ISRO?
record.explanation: Answer A: GSLV MkIII. ISRO records that its second developmental GSLV Mk III flight, GSLV Mk III-D 2, launched GSAT-29 on 14 November 2018 from Sriharikota. GSLV Mk III is the printed vehicle choice that matches the original mission record. Reference: https://www.isro.gov.in/mission_GSLVMkIIID2.html?timeline=timeline. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
